pages.title: Omnium Ingot
pages.text: A metal made of every concept, every material and every law, distilled into one bar. It has every property and none of them, depending on what you need. It is warm, cold, light and heavy at once, and feels like the end of the line.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnium block was too dense to shape, so I cracked a single ingot back out of it at the crafting grid. Whatever else I make from here, it starts with this.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex, Omnipotence Dust, Omnium Energy Cell.
